. . . CreatureConnect: Shared Control
Comparison with Our Previous Study Wang et al, CHI'26
METHODOLOGY COMPARISON
SensorySafari (CHI 2025, previous study, separate technologies)
Independent devices; parallel human and lemur interactions
CreatureConnect (CHI 2026, current study, connected-system)
Synchronous devices; shared cross-species control
RESULTS
More management-related talk in educational conversation assessment.
More social and empathy-related talk in educational conversation assessment.
Higher visitor experience ratings.
Longer lemur interaction duration per activation event.

transcript:
CreatureConnect: Shared Control
Discussion | Wang et al., CHI’26
- Our results challenge the assumption in ACI that giving animals
more control necessarily leads to greater engagement. Instead, we
found that the dynamics and negotiation of control between
species shape the outcomes of animal engagement.
* Our findings extend HCI by framing technology not merely as a tool,
but as a mediator of cross-species collaboration, highlighting
perceptual diversity and dynamically shared control as design
resources rather than constraints.
